title: Wardrobe and Silence
author: Rosalind Quintana
blurb: Theo Nystrom, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
